title: Function Examples
text: example shows race times cleaned standardized:
code:
# Example time strings that might appear in race results example_times <- c("1:23.45", "DNF", "2:15.30", "DNS", "1:45.20")  cat("Example 1: Cleaning individual race times
") #> Example 1: Cleaning individual race times cat("----------------------------------------
") #> ----------------------------------------  # Note: clean_race_time is an internal function, but we can demonstrate the concept for (i in seq_along(example_times)) {   cat(sprintf("Original: %s
", example_times[i]))      # Simple time parsing demonstration   if (toupper(example_times[i]) %in% c("DNF", "DNS")) {     cat(sprintf("  Status: %s
", toupper(example_times[i])))     cat("  Cleaned: NA
")   } else if (grepl(":", example_times[i])) {     parts <- strsplit(example_times[i], ":")[[1]]     if (length(parts) == 2) {       minutes <- as.numeric(parts[1])       seconds <- as.numeric(parts[2])       total_seconds <- minutes * 60 + seconds       cat("  Status: FINISHED
")       cat(sprintf("  Cleaned: %.2f seconds
", total_seconds))     }   }   cat("----------------------------------------
") } #> Original: 1:23.45 #>   Status: FINISHED #>   Cleaned: 83.45 seconds #> ---------------------------------------- #> Original: DNF #>   Status: DNF #>   Cleaned: NA #> ---------------------------------------- #> Original: 2:15.30 #>   Status: FINISHED #>   Cleaned: 135.30 seconds #> ---------------------------------------- #> Original: DNS #>   Status: DNS #>   Cleaned: NA #> ---------------------------------------- #> Original: 1:45.20 #>   Status: FINISHED #>   Cleaned: 105.20 seconds #> ----------------------------------------

")   for (i in seq_along(race_ids)) {     cat(sprintf("%d. %s
", i, race_ids[i]))   }      if (length(race_ids) > 0) {     # Get the first race as a clean data frame     first_race <- get_race(file_path, race_ids[1])          cat(sprintf("
Analyzing race: %s
", race_ids[1]))     cat(sprintf("Number of participants: %d
", nrow(first_race)))     cat(sprintf("Number of columns: %d
", ncol(first_race)))     cat("Column names:", paste(names(first_race), collapse = ", "), "
")          # Show first few rows     if (nrow(first_race) > 0) {       cat("
First few participants:
")       print(head(first_race, 3))     }          # Analyze time data if available (look for "Overall Time" or similar columns)     time_col <- NULL     for (col in c("Overall Time", "overall_time", "time", "Time")) {       if (col %in% names(first_race)) {         time_col <- col         break       }     }          if (!is.null(time_col)) {       time_values <- first_race[[time_col]]       # Try to convert to numeric       time_numeric <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(time_values))       finished_times <- time_numeric[!is.na(time_numeric)]              if (length(finished_times) > 0) {         cat("
Race Statistics:
")         cat("- Participants with times:", length(finished_times), "
")         cat("- Fastest time:", min(finished_times), "
")         cat("- Slowest time:", max(finished_times), "
")         cat("- Average time:", round(mean(finished_times), 2), "
")       }              # Count DNS, DNF, DSQ       time_char <- as.character(time_values)       dns_count <- sum(grepl("^DNS$", time_char, ignore.case = TRUE))       dnf_count <- sum(grepl("^DNF$", time_char, ignore.case = TRUE))       dsq_count <- sum(grepl("^DSQ$", time_char, ignore.case = TRUE))              if (dns_count > 0 || dnf_count > 0 || dsq_count > 0) {         cat("

title: Getting Started with skiResultsR
text: skiResultsR package provides comprehensive set functions extracting analyzing ski race results HTML files generated skiresults.co.uk. vignette guide main features show extract structured data ski race events.

title: Getting Started with skiResultsR
code: # Install from GitHub (when available) # devtools::install_github("yourusername/skiResultsR")  # Or install locally devtools::install()

title: Getting Started with skiResultsR
code: library(skiResultsR)

title: Getting Started with skiResultsR
text: package includes sample HTML files ski race events. Let’s start locating sample file:
code:
# Get path to sample data # Try system.file first, then fall back to direct path for development file_path <- system.file("extdata", "chatham_oct2023.html", package = "skiResultsR")  # If system.file doesn't work (during development/check), try direct path if (!file.exists(file_path) || file_path == "") {   file_path <- file.path("inst", "extdata", "chatham_oct2023.html") }  # Check if file exists if (file.exists(file_path)) {   cat("Sample file found:", basename(file_path), "
")   cat("File size:", file.size(file_path), "bytes
") } else {   cat("Sample file not found in either location
")   cat("Tried system.file and direct path
") } #> Sample file found: chatham_oct2023.html  #> File size: 377939 bytes

title: Getting Started with skiResultsR
text: skiResultsR package provides six main functions, organized primary helper functions:

title: Getting Started with skiResultsR
text: get_event() - Extract complete event data (recommended starting point) get_races() - Extract race tables event get_race() - Extract specific race race type/ID

title: Getting Started with skiResultsR
text: get_racers() - Extract unique racer information profile links get_points() - Extract racer points across categories get_event_summary() - Extract event metadata (title, date, venue, etc.)

title: Getting Started with skiResultsR
text: easiest way start get_event(), extracts available information: get_event() function returns nested list event_id name. inner element (accessed event_data[[1]]) contains: event_dtls: Event details (title, date, slope, format, status) race_types: Race types information races: race tables complete race information racers: Unique racers profile links club information points: Points data across categories races clubs: Club information found event

# Get a specific race for analysis races <- get_races(file_path) if (length(races) > 0) {   race_data <- get_race(file_path, names(races)[1])      # Analyze time data if available (look for "Overall Time" or similar columns)   time_col <- NULL   for (col in c("Overall Time", "overall_time", "time", "Time")) {     if (col %in% names(race_data)) {       time_col <- col       break     }   }      if (!is.null(time_col)) {     time_values <- race_data[[time_col]]     # Try to convert to numeric     time_numeric <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(time_values))     finished_times <- time_numeric[!is.na(time_numeric)]          if (length(finished_times) > 0) {       cat("Race Statistics:
")       cat("- Participants with times:", length(finished_times), "
")       cat("- Fastest time:", min(finished_times), "
")       cat("- Slowest time:", max(finished_times), "
")       cat("- Average time:", round(mean(finished_times), 2), "
")     }          # Count DNS, DNF, DSQ     time_char <- as.character(time_values)     dns_count <- sum(grepl("^DNS$", time_char, ignore.case = TRUE))     dnf_count <- sum(grepl("^DNF$", time_char, ignore.case = TRUE))     dsq_count <- sum(grepl("^DSQ$", time_char, ignore.case = TRUE))          if (dns_count > 0 || dnf_count > 0 || dsq_count > 0) {       cat("
Status Distribution:
")       cat("- DNS:", dns_count, "
")       cat("- DNF:", dnf_count, "
")       cat("- DSQ:", dsq_count, "
")     }   } else {     cat("No time column found in race data
")   } } #> Race Statistics: #> - Participants with times: 90  #> - Fastest time: 31.13  #> - Slowest time: 74.57  #> - Average time: 45.26  #>  #> Status Distribution: #> - DNS: 4  #> - DNF: 3  #> - DSQ: 0
